notes.title: Manny Boxing VR 1.3.1 Ver Hotfix Update and Apology
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42381876/e6f3e15ba530eaba6c42176cf7fcdefc1fa37623.png[/img]

Hello, Manny Boxing VR players.

We have recently received reports from some players regarding issues where certain parts of the game were not playable. We take this issue seriously and have implemented a **1.3.1 Ver Hotfix Update** to address it.

1.3.1 Ver Hotfix Update Details:
- Fixed an issue where certain parts of the game were not playable under specific conditions.
- Optimized server communication for improved stability.

This update will be applied today, so we recommend all players update to the latest version. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused, and we will continue to work hard to provide a better gaming experience.

Thank you,  
Appnori Team

notes.title: Patch Notes V_1.1.0 / ChampionShip Mode Added.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42381876/66c06eaad92d330500bf199eb1b12d5e25c5237d.png[/img]

[h1]1.1.0 Version Update!![/h1]

Hello, Champions!

A major update for Manny is coming on May 31, 2024! This update includes exciting new features that will enhance your gaming experience. Check it out now!

[h2]Major Updates[/h2]
[olist]
[*]ChampionShip Mode Added
The new ChampionShip mode starts at rank 100 and challenges you to face Manny. Aim for the top and claim the Champion Belt. It’s your time to shine!

[*]Customizing Feature Added
You can now customize your character in single-player mode. Create your unique style and enjoy a more personalized gaming experience!

[*]Two New Maps Added
Explore two brand new maps, each offering unique challenges and adventures. Dive into the excitement of these new environments!

[*]Existing Maps Renewal
Our existing maps have been revamped with better graphics and improved gameplay experience, providing a more immersive gaming adventure.

[*]Announcer and Narrator Added
Professional announcers and narrators have been brought in to bring your matches to life. Enjoy more thrilling and realistic game commentaries!

[*]Background Music Renewal
Thirteen new background tracks have been added. Enhance the atmosphere of the arena with a variety of exciting new music!
[/olist]

This update will make the game more diverse and thrilling. We look forward to your continued support and hope you have a fantastic time with Manny!

Thank you.

[b][ Appnori Inc. ][/b]
